_source: What is actually inside the programme the club uploads for a fixture.
_rule: The download band used to describe the programme THE GENERATOR draws (a half-time quiz, a squad word search, the registered list), and the club now uploads its own document instead, so those lines were a guess about a file nobody had read. A fixture named here describes its own PDF; a fixture with no entry falls back to the derived list, which is still true of a generated programme.
